card.text: The Owl Nebula is a planetary nebula about 811 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G148.4+57.0: distance 811 pc (782 to 842) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star
Wikipedia, "Owl Nebula"
sources.quote: The Owl Nebula is a planetary nebula approximately 2,030 light years away in the constellation Ursa Major.

introduction.text: A Sloan Digital Sky Survey image of it fills here the nebula's published body: a ball of gas 0.86 pc across with cavities along its pole, the owl's eyes.

sources.label: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
sources.locator: SDSS9 color; SDSS g, r and i

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Owl Nebula"
sources.quote: Estimated to be about 8,000 years old, it is approximately circular in cross-section with a faint internal structure.

sources.label: García-Díaz et al. (2018), MNRAS 479, 3909: The Owl and other strigiform nebulae: multipolar cavities within a filled shell
sources.locator: Sect. 2.3 and 3: a filled, slightly prolate spheroid inclined about 25 degrees, north-west half toward Earth; a multipolar cavity that emits 0.3 of the gas around it; three lobes, north-west toward us, south-east one toward us and one away

sources.label: Guerrero et al. (2003), AJ 125, 3213: Physical structure of planetary nebulae. I. The Owl Nebula
sources.locator: Sect. III and IV: an ellipsoid of radius 93 arcsec along the pole and 83 arcsec across it; eyes about 35 arcsec in size; a filled envelope 218 arcsec across; denser gas along the equatorial plane
